Donglin Buddha is a religious site of the Pure Land Sect.

Located in Lushan Hot Spring Town, Jiangxi Province, on the southern foot of Lushan Mountain; 48 meters high, it is the tallest golden statue of Amitabha Buddha in the world. 48 kilograms of gold were used to gild the entire body.
There are 949 steps in total.
The Buddha is 48 meters high and 81 meters in total.
It sits on a 48-petal lotus platform, which embodies the 48 great vows made by Amitabha Buddha to save all living beings.
The Buddha's right palm is facing forward and hanging down in a welcoming gesture; his left hand is placed on his chest, holding a lotus, which is protected by a dome.
The Pure Land Garden of Donglin Temple (the management of Donglin Buddha) has been approved as a Buddhist temple by the State Administration of Religious Affairs.
All construction funds come from donations from believers and kind-hearted people from all over the world.
After completion, it will be open to the public free of charge and will not be operated commercially. 🚌: It is about 30 km away from Jiujiang Railway Station.
The Up owner drove himself, and it seems that there is no bus or coach going from Jiujiang City.
Note: Do not wear short skirts, tight skirts, or revealing clothing.
If you do, there are free black skirts to borrow on the right before entering the hall.
Opening hours: 8:00-17:00.
Admission is free.
Worried about tiring your kids or getting lost while hiking Lushan?
Actually, with a good plan, it’s super easy!
This article covers tickets, routes, and accommodation thoroughly—new parents can just copy the plan👇 1.
Basic Information About Lushan to Note Lushan ticket 💰160 RMB is really worth it!
Valid for 7 days, you can visit the core mountain scenic spots plus 8 surrounding scenic areas.
But remember, shuttle buses, cable cars, and small trains inside the park charge extra.
Don’t impulsively buy combo tickets with kids; choose based on your needs to save money. 2.

Family-Friendly Route Summary No need to cover all routes with kids, just pick these few—easy and fun: - **West Line (Top choice for families)**: Huajing → Ruqin Lake → Jinxiu Valley → Xianren Cave → Datian Pool → Dam.
The path is flat and scenic, with many resting spots along the way.
Kids can walk easily and stop anytime to enjoy the view. - **Middle Line (Relaxed sightseeing and eating)**: Meilu Villa → Former Site of Lushan Conference → Lushan Museum → Lulin Lake.
After sightseeing, you can find a small local restaurant nearby to try local specialties, and kids can rest their feet. - **East Line (Nature exploration)**: Hanpoukou → Wulao Peak → Sandie Spring.

Watching the sunrise at Hanpoukou with kids is very meaningful, and you must experience the waterfall at Sandie Spring up close—kids will love it. - **Outer Ring Line (Cultural experience)**: Sandie Spring → Bailudong Academy → Xiufeng → Donglin Giant Buddha.
The academy lets kids learn about ancient scholars’ lives, and the giant Buddha is magnificent, perfect for photos. 3.
Transportation Tips to Avoid Pitfalls - You can take high-speed rail to either Jiujiang Station or Lushan Station.
Taxi from Jiujiang Station to East Gate costs about 💰120 RMB and is also close to the North Gate; taxi from Lushan Station to South Gate costs about 💰25 RMB.
Choose the station based on the scenic spots you want to visit. - Families with kids should prioritize taxis or self-driving!

If there are 4 people, taking a taxi is cheaper than bus plus shuttle, and you don’t have to squeeze with kids on public transport—super convenient. - If driving, there are plenty of parking lots on the mountain, but during peak season, you may need to arrive early to secure a spot.

Having a car lets you adjust your itinerary anytime, and kids can rest in the car when tired. 4. 1-3 Day Family Route Plans - **1-Day Special Forces Route (for tight schedules)**: Stay at the foot of Xiufeng!

Wake up to the beautiful view of “Watching the waterfall hanging in front of the river” → Visit Sandie Spring (ticket 65 RMB, round trip 3 hours, walk slowly with kids) → Lunch and pick up luggage at Xiufeng → Donglin Giant Buddha (free!

Beautiful Tang-style architecture, climbing steps with kids is meaningful) → Return from Lushan Station. - **2-Day Relaxed Route**: - Day 1: Enter from West Gate → Huajing → Ruqin Lake → Jinxiu Valley → Xianren Cave → Stay in Guling Town (evening stroll in the town) - Day 2: Hanpoukou (watch sunrise) → Meilu Villa → Lulin Lake → Sandie Spring → Exit East Gate - **3-Day In-Depth Route**: - Day 1: Enter from North Gate → Datian Pool → Xianren Cave → Jinxiu Valley → Ruqin Lake → Huajing → Guling Town - Day 2: Hanpoukou → Wulao Peak → Sandie Spring → Lulin Lake → Lushan Museum - Day 3: Meilu Villa → Bailudong Academy → Donglin Giant Buddha → Return 5.
Accommodation Recommendation (Top Wild Luxury) Good accommodation means better fun with kids!
Recommended is **Lushan Wanglu Wild Luxury Hotel**, not far from Guling Town’s core area, about a 10-minute drive.
The hotel is built halfway up the mountain, each room has a huge viewing terrace to enjoy green mountains and waters by day and starry skies by night.
The hotel offers special family rooms with small tents and toys, making kids super happy as soon as they enter.
They also provide family activities like crafts and tea picking, so parents can relax while kids have fun.
Breakfast even includes kids’ exclusive meals—super thoughtful~ 6.
Tips for Traveling with Kids 1.
Choose your routes first, then book your high-speed rail station to avoid unnecessary detours. 2.
If you don’t drive, don’t hesitate to take taxis; taxis in Lushan are very convenient and reasonably priced. 3.
Staying at the foot of Xiufeng offers great value for money, about half the price of Guling Town.
If you plan to explore the outer ring line, you can stay there. 4.
Lushan is most beautiful after rain!
Waterfalls are fuller, and the air is fresh.
Choose rainy days for your trip with kids to double the experience. 5.
Don’t worry about tiring kids at Sandie Spring; there are resting platforms along the way, so walking slowly is no problem.
Seeing the waterfall up close is truly breathtaking.
🕰️Opening Hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM (last entry at 4:30 PM).
Closed on Mondays (except public holidays). 🏖️Environment/Facilities: The site features Tang Dynasty-style architecture, including structures like the Mountain Gate and the Three Saints Hall.

Highlights include the 949-step Pilgrimage Path, the world's tallest 48-meter-high Amitabha Buddha statue, an underground palace beneath the Buddha platform housing over 100 3D Buddha statues, as well as scenic spots like the Heart-Cleansing Pool and the Release Pool.

Additional amenities include a vegetarian dining hall and rest pavilions. 📍Address: Wenquan Town, Lushan City, Jiujiang, Jiangxi Province, along National Highway 105. 💰Average Cost: Admission is free, incense offerings are free; vegetarian meals cost around 20 RMB per person (some can be offset with free vouchers), nearby dining options range from 30-50 RMB per person, and accommodations in the area cost 150-300 RMB per night. 💞Why Visit: Home to the world's tallest Amitabha Buddha statue, the site is free of commercialization, offering a pure Buddhist cultural and spiritual experience.
